# fetchquack

> fetchquack is a lightweight, universal HTTP client built on the standard Fetch API. It provides first-class support for streaming responses, Server-Sent Events (SSE) with auto-reconnect, upload/download progress tracking, and an interceptor middleware system. It works on Browser, Node.js 18+, Bun 1.0+, Deno 1.11+, and has an Angular 17+ wrapper with RxJS Observable support. Zero runtime dependencies, ~4KB minified+gzipped.

Key things to know:

- `fetch()` returns `Promise<T>` for standard HTTP requests
- `fetchStream()` and `sse()` return `void` and deliver data through callbacks (`onData`, `onEvent`, `onError`, `onComplete`). Use `AbortController` for cancellation — they do NOT return an abort function
- `HttpError` has `statusCode`, `message`, and `error?` properties only (no `statusText` or `response`)
- `HttpJsonParseError` extends `HttpError` (not `Error` directly)
- All `SseEvent` fields (`id`, `event`, `data`, `retry`) are optional
- All `RetryPolicyConfig` fields are optional. Defaults: maxRetries=0 (unlimited), initialInterval=3000, maxInterval=30000, backoffMultiplier=2, jitter=1000
- The Angular wrapper (`fetchquack/ngx`) returns Observables for `fetchStream()` and `sse()`, and supports both Promise and Observable modes for `fetch()`
- Built-in interceptors are imported from subpaths: `fetchquack/interceptors/auth`, `fetchquack/interceptors/logging`, `fetchquack/interceptors/header`, `fetchquack/interceptors/csrf`

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://adrian-bueno.github.io/fetchquack/getting-started/introduction): Overview of what fetchquack is, why it exists, and key features
- [Installation](https://adrian-bueno.github.io/fetchquack/getting-started/installation): npm/yarn/pnpm/bun install commands and per-platform requirements
- [Quick Start](https://adrian-bueno.github.io/fetchquack/getting-started/quick-start): Hands-on examples covering basic requests, streaming, SSE, progress, errors, cancellation, and interceptors

## Core Concepts

- [HTTP Client](https://adrian-bueno.github.io/fetchquack/core/http-client): HttpClient class, configuration options, method signatures, multiple clients, TypeScript generics, platform compatibility
- [Requests & Responses](https://adrian-bueno.github.io/fetchquack/core/requests-responses): HTTP methods, request body types (JSON, text, FormData, binary), response handling (JSON, text, binary), HttpRequest interface, cancellation, error classes (HttpError, HttpJsonParseError)
- [Interceptors](https://adrian-bueno.github.io/fetchquack/core/interceptors): Middleware system, built-in interceptors (auth, logging, header, CSRF) with all options, custom interceptor examples, HttpInterceptorContext interface, global vs request-level interceptors, execution order

## Features

- [Streaming](https://adrian-bueno.github.io/fetchquack/features/streaming): fetchStream() for text and binary streaming, AI chat streaming, log streaming, file download, NDJSON, cancellation via AbortController, Angular Observable integration
- [Server-Sent Events](https://adrian-bueno.github.io/fetchquack/features/sse): sse() for SSE connections, JSON parsing, auto-reconnect with retry policy, custom event types, POST method SSE, Last-Event-ID tracking, Angular Observable integration
- [Progress Tracking](https://adrian-bueno.github.io/fetchquack/features/progress): Upload and download progress via onUploadProgress/onDownloadProgress callbacks, HttpProgressEvent interface, platform-specific implementations
- [Retry Policies](https://adrian-bueno.github.io/fetchquack/features/retry): RetryPolicyConfig for SSE auto-reconnect, exponential backoff formula, unlimited/fast/constant retry presets, custom retry interceptor for regular requests

## Integrations

- [Angular](https://adrian-bueno.github.io/fetchquack/integrations/angular): NgxHttpClient service, provideNgxHttpClient setup, Promise and Observable modes, RxJS streaming/SSE, dependency injection in interceptors, progress tracking, service pattern, testing

## API Reference

- [API Reference](https://adrian-bueno.github.io/fetchquack/api): Complete reference for all classes, interfaces, types, and functions including HttpClient, NgxHttpClient, HttpRequest, HttpStreamRequest, HttpSseRequest, HttpProgressEvent, SseEvent, RetryPolicyConfig, HttpInterceptorFn, HttpError, HttpJsonParseError, and all built-in interceptors
